title: Find Common Characters
description:
Given a string array words, return an array of all characters that show up in all strings within the words (including duplicates). You may return the answer in any order.
 
Example 1:
Input: words = ["bella","label","roller"]
Output: ["e","l","l"]
Example 2:
Input: words = ["cool","lock","cook"]
Output: ["c","o"]

 
Constraints:

1 <= words.length <= 100
1 <= words[i].length <= 100
words[i] consists of lowercase English letters.
starter_code:
class Solution:
    def commonChars(self, words: List[str]) -> List[str]:

check_function:
def check(candidate):
    assert candidate(words=["bella","label","roller"]) == ["e","l","l"]
    assert candidate(words=["cool","lock","cook"]) == ["c","o"]
    assert candidate(words=["a","a","a"]) == ["a"]
    assert candidate(words=["ab","bc","cd"]) == []
    assert candidate(words=["zzzz","zz","zzz"]) == ["z","z"]
    assert candidate(words=["abc","abc","abc"]) == ["a","b","c"]
    assert candidate(words=["aabbcc","abbbcc","abbccc"]) == ["a","b","b","c","c"]
    assert candidate(words=["hello","yellow","mellow"]) == ["e","l","l","o"]
    assert candidate(words=["cool","pool","tool"]) == ["o","o","l"]
